correctness.rationale: The exact rational function and generator normalization are specified. A unique positive real pole is isolated by a strictly monotone cubic. A certified polynomial remainder proves strict real-residue dominance; the complex pair is no nearer at or below the exact tie, giving all nonnegative Taylor coefficients and a convex combination of stochastic uniformization powers. Beyond the tie the leading complex pair yields negative high derivatives, each realized as a pure-birth transition. A separate exact derivative quartic and positive complementary entries establish the two reentrant three-state positivity intervals. The standalone checker reproduces exact identities and finite witnesses; infinitude follows analytically.

value.rationale: The fixed three-stage Radau IIA solver is a canonical stiff fifth-order method. A sharp dimension-free exit-rate CFL threshold for all finite directed Markov chains is a natural operational design quantity. Proving saturation rather than merely restating the published pole upper bound requires a strict residue comparison. The every-timestep pure-birth converse and exact small-state positivity-reentrance phase diagram clarify a genuine safety limit for positivity-constrained numerical evolution and distinguish global method guarantees from individual-chain behavior.
